power.rule: Lights ON when something is alive: a fresh agent log, a manager run, or the local app heartbeat. Lights OFF (office closed, every agent asleep) when the newest activity is older than quiet_minutes — that is the 'laptop off / office closed' state.

agent_visuals.working: sitting, typing, monitor on, progress bar above the desk, efficiency meter on the desk edge
agent_visuals.at_risk: yawning at the desk, amber warning — log is between 30 and 60 minutes old
agent_visuals.sleeping_dead: asleep with red Zzz — over 60 minutes of silence while marked working: needs a replacement (handover.py)
agent_visuals.sleeping_off: asleep with grey Zzz — staged, never started: needs the owner to paste its start prompt
agent_visuals.blocked: standing with a red exclamation — the blocker text is on the desk card
agent_visuals.review: holding a paper with an amber question mark — waiting on the Manager
agent_visuals.done: sparkles and a gold star for the run's top producer
agent_visuals.vacant: empty chair, desk lamp off, VACANT sign
